scope: Post hoc comparison on all 80 statements of the published confirmation partition, two existing models; secondary control only.
rule: Use series B second pass with identical wording, parameters, parsing and error handling. Retain the second label for every statement. The judge sees only source, statement and first direct label. Score against frozen labels only after all replies have been collected. No prompt or threshold changes.
comparisons: Per model: first Direct, two-pass Direct, Fusion. Count correct, recoveries, regressions, abstentions and logical costs. Compare Fusion-minus-two-pass accuracy with 2000 trial-paired bootstrap draws.
